run_simple_method: run a unary-unary gRPC call that sends one request and receives one response from the server
run_client_streaming_method: run a client-streaming gRPC call that sends multiple requests to the server and receives one response
run_server_streaming_method: run a server-streaming gRPC call that sends one request and receives multiple responses from the server
run_bidirectional_streaming_method: run a bidirectional-streaming gRPC call where both client and server exchange multiple messages
run_grpc_client_main: run the gRPC client that demonstrates all four data transmission methods against a local server
